14tc0jv:249: Experimental method: write the spec first, then let AI generate the code, and finally validate against the spec. The full implementation was ~6k lines of code—40% application code, 40% tests, 20% auto-generated GraphQL files. The spec review phase produced 14 acceptance criteria and 65 checkable items. A second agent validated all 65 items in 6 minutes, producing a structured report: 60 passed, 4 failed, 1 partially passed. Human reviewers left an average of 10 comments per PR, but the main bug they found was stale editor state.
